sources.entry: Dimsum - Minimalist menu bar app that dims inactive windows to highlight the focused one. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/nshi/dimsum) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Dimsum is a minimalist macOS menu bar utility that dims all unfocused windows so the focused window stands out.
summary.what_it_does: Runs as a menu bar app with no Dock icon. A popover provides an Enable Dimming toggle, a Dimming Intensity slider from 0 (no dim) to 1 (fully black) that applies in real time, and a Start on Login option that registers it as a login item. It dims unfocused windows across all displays and animates overlays when focus changes by click or Cmd+Tab. The README says full-screen apps and Space transitions are handled automatically. Dimming requires macOS Accessibility permission.
use_cases: highlight the active window on macOS
reduce visual clutter in busy workspaces
how_to_run: curl -L -o /tmp/Dimsum.zip <download URL from the releases page> && unzip -o /tmp/Dimsum.zip -d /Applications && rm /tmp/Dimsum.zip && open /Applications/Dimsum.app
Grant Accessibility permission in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility
notable: Dims unfocused windows across all displays with an adjustable intensity slider
Menu bar only app with no Dock icon
Optional self-signed certificate script keeps Accessibility permission across rebuilds
Start on Login option through a login item
caveats: Not notarized, so Gatekeeper may block the app on first launch
Ad-hoc builds lose the Accessibility grant on every rebuild unless signed with a self-signed certificate
